language.description: The language you want the typed models generated for.
language.name: language

file.description: Path or URL to the AsyncAPI document, or context-name
file.name: file

output.description: The output directory where the models should be written to. Omitting this flag will write the models to `stdout`.
output.name: output

packageName.description: Go, Java and Kotlin specific, define the package to use for the generated models. This is required when language is `go`, `java` or `kotlin`.
packageName.name: packageName

namespace.description: C#, C++ and PHP specific, define the namespace to use for the generated models. This is required when language is `csharp`,`c++` or `php`.
namespace.name: namespace

tsModelType.description: TypeScript specific, define which type of model needs to be generated.
tsModelType.name: tsModelType

tsEnumType.description: TypeScript specific, define which type of enums needs to be generated.
tsEnumType.name: tsEnumType

tsModuleSystem.description: TypeScript specific, define the module system to be used.
tsModuleSystem.name: tsModuleSystem

tsIncludeComments.description: TypeScript specific, if enabled add comments while generating models.
tsIncludeComments.name: tsIncludeComments

tsExportType.description: TypeScript specific, define which type of export needs to be generated.
tsExportType.name: tsExportType

tsJsonBinPack.description: TypeScript specific, define basic support for serializing to and from binary with jsonbinpack.
tsJsonBinPack.name: tsJsonBinPack

tsMarshalling.description: TypeScript specific, generate the models with marshalling functions.
tsMarshalling.name: tsMarshalling

tsExampleInstance.description: Typescript specific, generate example of the model.
tsExampleInstance.name: tsExampleInstance

tsRawPropertyNames.description: Typescript specific, generate the models using raw property names.
tsRawPropertyNames.name: tsRawPropertyNames

csharpAutoImplement.description: C# specific, define whether to generate auto-implemented properties or not.
csharpAutoImplement.name: csharpAutoImplement

csharpNewtonsoft.description: C# specific, generate the models with newtonsoft serialization support
csharpNewtonsoft.name: csharpNewtonsoft

csharpArrayType.description: C# specific, define which type of array needs to be generated.
csharpArrayType.name: csharpArrayType

csharpHashcode.description: C# specific, generate the models with the GetHashCode method overwritten
csharpHashcode.name: csharpHashcode

csharpEqual.description: C# specific, generate the models with the Equal method overwritten
csharpEqual.name: csharpEqual

csharpSystemJson.description: C# specific, generate the models with System.Text.Json serialization support
csharpSystemJson.name: csharpSystemJson

goIncludeComments.description: Golang specific, if enabled add comments while generating models.
goIncludeComments.name: goIncludeComments

goIncludeTags.description: Golang specific, if enabled add tags while generating models.
goIncludeTags.name: goIncludeTags

javaIncludeComments.description: Java specific, if enabled add comments while generating models.
javaIncludeComments.name: javaIncludeComments

javaJackson.description: Java specific, generate the models with Jackson serialization support
javaJackson.name: javaJackson

javaConstraints.description: Java specific, generate the models with constraints
javaConstraints.name: javaConstraints

javaArrayType.description: Java specific, define which type of array needs to be generated.
javaArrayType.name: javaArrayType

pyDantic.description: Python specific, generate the Pydantic models.
pyDantic.name: pyDantic

spec-file-path.description: file path of the spec file
spec-file-path.name: spec-file-path

config:context:add.description: Add a context to the store

set-current.description: Set context being added as the current context
set-current.name: set-current

config:context:current.description: Shows the current context that is being used

new-spec-file-path.description: file path of the spec file
new-spec-file-path.name: new-spec-file-path

config:context:edit.description: Edit a context in the store

config:context.description: Manage short aliases for full paths to inputs

context-file-path.description:
Specify directory in which context file should be created:
    - current directory          : modelina config context init . (default)
    - root of current repository : modelina config context init ./
    - user's home directory      : modelina config context init ~
context-file-path.name: context-file-path

config:context:init.contextFilePathMessage:
Specify directory in which context file should be created:
    - current directory          : modelina config context init . (default)
    - root of current repository : modelina config context init ./
    - user's home directory      : modelina config context init ~

config:context:list.description: List all the stored contexts in the store

context-name.description: Name of the context to delete
context-name.name: context-name

config:context:remove.description: Delete a context from the store
